composition_variation: Create a crisp editorial anime wallpaper showing a clearly adult 28-year-old woman reviewing a photograph at a bright sailboat dock. Her fine features include lively emerald eyes, softly defined cheekbones, a small nose, warm freckles, and a satisfied thoughtful smile. Give her a warm copper wavy bob, held neatly on one side by a small plain clip. She wears an opaque pale ocean-blue short-sleeved button-front shirt with a normal collar, ivory tailored linen trousers, comfortable loafers, and a narrow camera strap. She holds a compact silver camera with both hands at lower-chest height, looking down slightly at its back screen; her elbows remain comfortably near her ribs. Keep the screen dark and unreadable. A clean white sailboat hull appears in the middle distance, its mast kept below or away from the open central sky. Weathered dock boards and a single neat rope cleat give the scene believable scale. Choose copper, pale blue, cream, and sea-green color notes under clear morning light. Her body stays upright and naturally balanced, with meticulous hand anatomy and gentle rather than exaggerated expression. Use an eye-level portrait composition, with one person centered in the middle-to-lower frame and hands held within the central crop. Leave the upper quarter as clean pale sky or light for the lock-screen clock.
